links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease Score) of chatbot responses to orthodontic clear aligner patient questions
links.effect: Mean FRES 38.39 (ChatGPT-3.5), 43.88 (ChatGPT-4), 41.72 (Copilot), 54.12 (Gemini); responses difficult to read for most models.
links.quote: The mean FRES was 38.39 ± 11.56 for ChatGPT-3.5, 43.88 ± 10.13 for ChatGPT-4 and 41.72 ± 10.74 for Copilot, indicating that the responses were difficult to read according to the reading level.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs on patient-facing orthodontic FAQs for accuracy, reliability, quality, and readability without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
